_comment: Blast-radius map for the CAS regression guard. Maps high-blast-radius SHARED files to the 'done' modules that silently inherit their changes. /guard and the pre-push hook read this: for each changed file, union its dependents, then run those modules' pytest markers + e2e smoke. Maintained by the retro-agent and humans. See .claude/skills/guard/SKILL.md.
notes: Only the JS/browser layer is e2e-covered (pytest renders HTML but never executes JS). accounts_payable (test_ap_smoke.py) and sales_invoices (test_si_smoke.py) have smoke suites; mirror to cash_disbursements as it gets verified, then set its 'e2e' path here.
When you ADD a new shared file or a new module dependency, add it here in the SAME commit -- a stale map is a silent coverage hole.

MEASURE A MARKER'S POPULATION, never assume it (2026-08-05 /retro). Four modules listed as dependents above had markers that selected almost nothing while their tests existed and passed: opening_balances selected 7 of 51, customers 2 of 82, sales_vat 0 of 28, product_categories 0 of 15. Every union run that included them -- across many sessions -- reported a fraction of their coverage as if it were the whole thing, and NOTHING flagged it: the runs were green, the modules were listed here, the test files were real. A near-EMPTY marker is more dangerous than an empty one, because `0 selected` looks suspicious while `2 passed` reads as coverage. Fixed by adding pytestmark to 30 files + registering sales_vat/product_categories in pytest.ini (--strict-markers is on, so an unregistered mark errors rather than silently selecting nothing). All four now select their full by-path suite; 176 pass. Before trusting a union run, cross-check `pytest -m <module> --collect-only -q` against that module's test files counted BY PATH -- they should agree.

vat_settlement (CORRECTED 2026-08-18, second attempt -- the first correction fixed this note's WORDING without re-checking the CLAIM under it). This note used to say the marker was 'forward-wired for an unmerged branch' and that `pytest -m vat_settlement` legitimately selects 0. BOTH HALVES WERE FALSE: app/vat_settlement/ is shipped and deployed (models imported and blueprint registered in app/__init__.py; R-08/R-12 scored off it), with 7 test files / 33 tests that carried no marker -- and since tests/conftest.py's -m guard landed (834726d8) an unregistered name is a UsageError that runs ZERO tests and takes the whole union with it. So the four keys naming it (vat_categories/models.py, reports/vat_lines.py, reports/bir.py, reports/vat_return.py) left the client-facing BIR-filings surface guarded by a union that dropped the VAT-settlement engine. NOW FIXED: registered in pytest.ini and applied as pytestmark to all 7 files, `pytest -m vat_settlement` selects 33 == its by-path count. .claude/tests/test_guard.py::test_no_map_key_names_a_module_without_a_runnable_marker is the standing invariant that stops this recurring -- it fails if ANY dependent in this file has no registered marker, rather than waiting for someone to notice a dropped module.

R-02 purchase modules (purchase_orders/receiving_reports/purchase_requests, merged 2026-07-11) were FORWARD-WIRED and are NOW LIVE (2026-08-16): the markers are registered in pytest.ini and applied as module-level pytestmark, so `pytest -m purchase_orders` selects 337, purchase_requests 471, receiving_reports 218 -- each equal to that module's by-path count. They selected ZERO for five weeks while their tests existed and passed, so every union run naming them silently ran a smaller suite than it reported (measured: a 432-test union containing no PO/PR/RR test at all). --strict-markers does NOT validate a -m EXPRESSION, only a mark applied to a test, so the hollow run exited 0. Before trusting any union, read `--collect-only -q`'s selected count.

control_accounts (settings-assigned control accounts, BUG-POSTING-HARDCODED-CONTROL-ACCOUNTS, merged 2026-07-11): app/posting/control_accounts.py is the HIGH-blast resolver every posting engine + the memo JE builder + the BIR books report call -- its blast_radius edges are live, so a resolver change already unions and runs the sales_invoices/cash_receipts/accounts_payable/cash_disbursements/reports/credit_memos/debit_memos suites (which DO carry markers). The 'control_accounts' module marker was FORWARD-WIRED and is NOW LIVE (2026-08-16): registered in pytest.ini and applied to its test files, `pytest -m control_accounts` selects 112, equal to its by-path count; no e2e smoke for the settings page yet (backlog).

SI/AP per-transaction control-account fields (merged 2026-07-12, cas main e1c8979): the standalone app/control_accounts/ blueprint was retired -- its Control Accounts settings page (assigns the global-default AR-Trade/AP-Trade/Creditable-WHT/WHT-Payable accounts that SI/AP/CD/CR still fall back to) now lives as two routes inside app/company_settings/views.py. The map entry moved with it; do not re-add app/control_accounts/views.py (deleted).

app/journals/views.py (VOUCHER_TYPES) and app/reports/general_journal_data.py (VOUCHER_ENTRY_TYPES) are the voucher-type registry EVERY new JE-posting module must join, or its posted entries go invisible in the General Journal / Books of Accounts report -- Bank Transfers shipped exactly this gap once (entry_type='transfer' initially unregistered, caught only by whole-branch review, R-04 slice 2). Added 2026-07-19 (/retro, R-04 arc completion) after the same class recurred as a near-miss risk across Petty Cash Replenishment and Bank Reconciliation's own entry_type additions. The 'journals' module marker already exists in pytest.ini and 5+ test files (test_ap_journal_columnar.py, test_cd_journal_views.py, test_cr_journal.py, test_journals.py, test_journals_output_vat_regression.py) -- this was a genuine missing registration, not a forward-wire.

A MODULE NAME IS NOT ALWAYS ITS MARKER, and guard.py used to join the module names (2026-08-18). The 'modules' table above carries the translation -- debit_memos' tests are marked credit_memos, sales_vat_categories' are marked sales_vat -- and guard.py ignored it, so 22 of the 97 keys here (app/templates/base.html, app/__init__.py, app/users/module_access.py and every app/posting/ and app/sales_memos/ file among them) printed a `-m` expression naming a marker no test carries. Before the conftest -m guard existed that silently under-selected; after it, the expression is a UsageError that collects NOTHING. guard.py now resolves each module through modules[<name>]['marker'], de-duplicates (credit_memos + debit_memos collapse to one term), and excludes+names any marker pytest.ini does not register. Pinned by .claude/tests/test_guard.py, including one test that hands the base.html expression to real pytest -- the mutation check confirms the pre-fix expression exits 4.

payroll (added 2026-08-18): registered in pytest.ini and applied as module-level pytestmark to 14 files, `pytest -m payroll` selects 221 == its by-path count. It was added because app/common/preprinted_texts.py has ELEVEN consumers -- every pre-printed document in the app -- and app/payroll/preprinted_layout.py was the one missing from its dependent list. Adding the dependent WITHOUT the marker would have been the 834726d8 hollow-marker bug all over again, except louder: the conftest guard would have failed the whole union. No e2e smoke for payroll yet (backlog).
